name: smwgraphics-mario-s-time-machine-nes-776bc
title: Mario's Time Machine! (NES) - 776BC
description:
The tileset used by 776BC in Mario's Time Machine! (NES), set in Olympia!

Uses FG3, doesn't include The Time Machine.

Be aware that some blocks don't act exactly like the original, due to how the game was programmed to set act as values per 8x8 tile, instead of per 16x16 tile.
